title: 图鉴与首领资料（图鉴与装备）（第 1／3 部分）

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵也许全是雌性，但她们并不全是不朽的。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS THEY CAN BREED WITH ANY MALE OF ANY SPECIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [由于她们能与任何物种的任何雄性繁殖，她们便带上了越来越多的有朽特征。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [等等，所以这意味着她们中有些*是*不朽的？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [的确，就我们所能看出的而言。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [任何一个在开阔处并且正在交战的精灵，无疑会是个年幼者。顶多一百岁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……哇……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [先别光顾着惊叹。保持警惕，才能挡住那些年轻精灵的攻击。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对，得集中精神。]

rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵也许全是雌性，但她们并不全是不朽的。]

rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]
[THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]
rows.current: Bossu: [几百年过去，]

rows.source: [AS THE CENTURIES HAVE GONE BY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们身上逐渐多了凡俗生灵的特征。]

rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [等等，所以这意味着她们中有些*是*不朽的？]

rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [没错，至少据我们目前了解是这样。]

rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [任何一个在开阔处并且正在交战的精灵，无疑会是个年幼者。顶多一百岁。]

rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]
[THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这……哇……]

rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着惊叹。要时刻保持警觉，才能击退那些年轻精灵的攻击。]

rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]
[RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对，得专注。]

rows.source: [THE ELVES OF SCEAFYA MAY ALL BE FEMALE]
rows.current: Bossu: [斯凯菲亚的精灵虽说全是女性，却并非个个都能长生不老。]

rows.source: [BUT THEY AREN'T ALL IMMORTAL.]
[THEY'VE TAKEN ON MORE AND MORE MORTAL CHARACTERISTICS]
rows.current: Bossu: [她们身上凡人的特征越来越多，]

rows.source: [AS THE CENTURIES HAVE GONE BY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [几百年来一直如此。]

rows.source: [WAIT, SO THAT MEANS SOME OF THEM *ARE* IMMORTAL?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [等等，所以这意味着她们中有些*是*不朽的？]

rows.source: [INDEED, AS FAR AS WE CAN TELL.]
rows.current: Bossu: [据我们掌握的情况，确实如此。]

rows.source: [ANY ELF THAT IS OUT IN THE OPEN AND ENGAGING IN COMBAT]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些公开现身、参加战斗的精灵，肯定都还年轻，最多也就一百岁。]

rows.source: [WILL NO DOUBT BE A YOUNGSTER. A HUNDRED YEARS OLD AT MOST.]
[THAT'S... WOW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……哇……]

rows.source: [DON'T GIVE IN TO AWE. YOU'LL NEED TO BE ON YOUR TOES]
rows.current: Bossu: [别光顾着惊叹。打起精神，才能挡住那些年轻精灵的攻击。]

rows.source: [IN ORDER TO REPEL THE YOUNG ELVES' ATTACKS.]
[RIGHT, GOTTA FOCUS.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对，得专注。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [LOTS OF THOSE RED FURRED FERAL CANINES AROUND, HUH?]
rows.current: Bossu: [周围这种红毛野犬还真不少，是吧？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE FEISTY FELLAS ARE CALLED "BARKERS".]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些带劲儿的家伙叫「吠犬」。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EEP! YOU'D THINK THEY MISTOOK ME FOR ONE OF THEIR OWN!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呜！简直像它们把我当成同类了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WELL, THERE IS MORE THAN A PASSING RESEMBLANCE...]
rows.current: Bossu: [嗯，还真不止一点点像……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OH COME ON! YOU'RE REALLY GOING TO MAKE THAT JOKE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [得了吧！你真要开这种玩笑？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HAHA, IN ANY CASE IT LOOKS LIKE YOU MAY HAVE ARRIVED]
rows.current: Bossu: [哈哈，不管怎样，看来你正好赶上了它们的繁殖季中期。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IN THE MIDDLE OF THEIR BREEDING SEASON.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T GET TAKEN OUT BY AN OVERLY AGGRESSIVE BARKER!]
rows.current: Bossu: [别被过于凶猛的吠犬放倒！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [...UNLESS THEY'RE PAYING FOR DINNER, OF COURSE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [……除非它们负责请你吃晚饭，当然。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HAR HAR...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哈、哈……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [W-WHAT'S UP WITH THESE ROBO BUGS THAT KEEP COMING AT ME?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这、这些一直朝我冲过来的机器虫是怎么回事？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YOU'D THINK THEY'D RUN OUT MATERIALS BY NOW!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [按理说它们的材料早该用光了吧！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MUCH OF THE ROBOTIC MATERIAL IN THAT OLD SPACE STATION]
rows.current: Bossu: [那座老太空站里的许多机械，都配有纳米机械回收系统。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE BUILT WITH NANOMECHANICAL RECYCLING SYSTEMS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NA-NO-MY-WHAT ANAL?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [纳——米——机……什么鸡？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BASICALLY THEY'RE DESIGNED TO SELF REPAIR ENDLESSLY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [简单说，它们被设计成能无限自我修复。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT USED TO BE A POPULAR LOW- MAINTENANCE DESIGN]
rows.current: Bossu: [这种低维护设计以前很受欢迎，直到后来人们发现，等它们过时以后，也没办法把它们拆开。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [UNTIL IT WAS REALIZED THAT THEY COULDN'T BE TAKEN]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [APART WHEN THEY BECAME OBSOLETE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY REPAIR THEM- SELVES FASTER THAN WE CAN BREAK EM!]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们自我修复的速度比我们破坏的还快！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AHH, SO THAT'S WHY I'VE NEVER SEEN THESE KIND OF]
rows.current: Yiffany: [啊，难怪我从小到大都没见过这种机器人……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ROBOTS WHILE GROWING UP...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...NEATO!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……真酷！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BOSSU! THIS IS AGENT YIFFAI, REQUESTING SUPPORT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏！我是特工伊吠，请求支援！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BOSSU HERE, WHAT'S THE PROBLEM, AGENT?]
rows.current: Bossu: [波苏 在此，出什么问题了，特工？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'VE ENCOUNTERED A HAYWIRE DRONE THAT SEEMS TO NEVER]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我碰上一架失控的无人机，即使在我把它们打爆之后，它们还是不停地刷出来。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [STOP SPAWNING AFTER I'VE DESTROYED THEM.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MUCH OF THE ROBOTIC MATERIAL IN THAT OLD SPACE STATION]
rows.current: Bossu: [那座旧太空站里的大量机械材料，都配有纳米机械回收系统。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE BUILT WITH NANOMECHANICAL RECYCLING SYSTEMS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [NA-NO-MY-WHAT ANAL?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [纳——米——机……什么鸡？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HEH, YOUR SISTER USED TO SAY THAT TOO.]
rows.current: Bossu: [嘿，你姐姐以前也这么说。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BASICALLY THEY'RE DESIGNED TO SELF REPAIR ENDLESSLY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [简单说，它们被设计成能无休止地自我修复。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT USED TO BE A POPULAR LOW- MAINTENANCE DESIGN]
rows.current: Bossu: [这种低维护设计以前很受欢迎，直到人们发现，等它们过时了，根本没法拆开。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [UNTIL IT WAS REALIZED THAT THEY COULDN'T BE TAKEN]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [APART WHEN THEY BECAME OBSOLETE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY REPAIR THEM- SELVES FASTER THAN WE CAN BREAK EM!]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们自我修复得比我们拆得还快！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT SOUNDS REALLY ANNOYING!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [听起来真是够烦人的！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT WAS. THAT'S WHY YOU DON'T SEE SUCH MACHINERY BACK]
rows.current: Bossu: [确实烦。所以你在老家还待在地面上、没上天时，看不到这种机器。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AT HOME WHILE TERRA- BOUND.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO IT'S POINTLESS TO TRY DESTROY THEM ALL...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那想把它们全毁掉也是白费力气……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOOD TO KNOW! YIFFAI OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [长见识了！伊吠通话完毕。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE SILVERY SPIKED ROBOS ARE CALLED "SPIKERS"]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些银色带刺的机器人叫做"SPIKERS"]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'RE ARE A BIT OF A NUISANCE, AREN'T THEY?]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们还真有点烦人，不是吗？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WHILE THOSE LOOK LIKE BUGS CRAWLING ON THE GROUND]
rows.current: Bossu: [虽说那些家伙看起来像在地上爬的虫子，它们其实是一具精巧的机械仿体。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY ARE ACTUALLY A CLEVER MECHA FASCIMILE.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE DON'T HAVE ENOUGH DATA TO SAY WHO MADE THEM]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们没有足够的资料判断是谁制造了它们，所以在那之前，先小心它们的刺吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SO JUST WATCH OUT FOR THEIR SPIKES IN THE MEANTIME.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [A VICIOUS, REGROWING PLANT CALLED THE "BULBER"]
rows.current: Bossu: [一种名为「球茎怪」的凶恶、会反复再生的植物，会朝任何靠近的陌生动物开火。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WILL SHOOT AT ANY UNKNOWN FAUNA THAT COMES NEARBY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT INCLUDES YOU, AGENT, SO BEST TO TAKE CARE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [也包括你，特工，所以最好多加小心。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE MACHINES BUMPING UP AND DOWN INCESSANTLY]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些不停上下弹跳的机器，是某种目前出现了故障的巡逻机器人。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ARE SOME SORT OF PATROL DROIDS THAT ARE CURRENTLY]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MALFUNCTIONING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY SHOULDN'T POSE A THREAT, JUST TRY TO AVOID THEM.]
rows.current: Bossu: [应该不构成威胁，尽量避开就好。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT? CAN'T I DESTROY THEM?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么？我不能把它们毁掉吗？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DON'T BE SO BRASH. SOMETIMES AVOIDING CONFLICT IS BEST.]
rows.current: Bossu: [别这么莽撞。有时避开冲突才是上策。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [R-RIGHT, I'LL TRY TO BE MINDFUL...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对、对，我会多留意的……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [GOOD LAD.]
rows.current: Bossu: [好小伙子。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BOSSU, THERE ARE SOME TURRETS HERE THAT ARE SIMILAR TO]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，这里的这些炮塔，跟我们在家乡训练时用的那种炮塔很像！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THE TURRETS WE USED FOR TRAINING BACK HOME!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT MODEL OF TURRET HAS BEEN STANDARD ISSUE FOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那种型号的炮塔作为制式装备，已经用了大约两个世纪。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE LAST COUPLE OF CENTURIES OR SO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WOAH, YOU'RE KIDDING!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哇，你是在开玩笑吧！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NOBODY'S REALLY TAKEN ON THE JOB OF REPLACING THOSE OLD]
rows.current: Bossu: [其实并没有人真的接下更换那些老旧自卫武器的工作。它们几乎从来不会坏，你也看到了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SELF DEFENSE WEAPONS. THEY ALMOST NEVER BREAK DOWN,]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS YOU CAN SEE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THANKFULLY A FEW WHACKS SEEMS TO STOP THEM STILL...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [还好敲上几下好像还能让它们停下来……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY BOSSU? THE TURRETS HERE SEEM KINDA FAMILIAR.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，波苏？这里的炮塔好像有点眼熟。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [DIDN'T WE USE SOMETHING SIMILAR, BACK IN... UMM...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我们是不是也用过类似的，在……嗯……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BACK IN TRAINING, THAT'S RIGHT YIFFAI.]
rows.current: Bossu: [在训练的时候，没错，伊吠。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THAT MODEL OF TURRET HAS BEEN STANDARD ISSUE FOR]
rows.current: Bossu: [那种型号的炮塔作为制式装备，已经用了大约两个世纪。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE LAST COUPLE OF CENTURIES OR SO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [A COUPLE OF CENTURIES?? NO WAY!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [两个世纪？？不可能吧！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YES WAY. NOBODY'S BOTHERED TRYING TO REPLACE THOSE OLD]
rows.current: Bossu: [当然有可能。没人费心去换那些老旧的自卫武器。它们几乎从来不会坏，你也看到了！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SELF DEFENSE WEAPONS. THEY ALMOST NEVER BREAK DOWN,]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS YOU CAN SEE!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THEY BREAK DOWN PRETTY EASILY IF I HIT THEM ENOUGH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [只要我多敲几下，它们坏得还挺容易……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE CEILING MOUNTED TURRETS HAVE GONE ALL HAYWIRE]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些装在天花板上的炮塔全都失控了，大概是电力系统损坏得太厉害的缘故]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PROBABLY DUE TO ALL THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM DAMAGE]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OH SO THEY AREN'T SUPPOSED TO BE SPINNING AROUND AND]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哦，所以它们本来不该那样转来转去，还那样乱开枪的？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SHOOTING INDISCRIMINATELY LIKE THAT?]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DEFINITELY NOT. TRY NOT TO STAY UNDER THEM FOR TOO LONG.]
rows.current: Bossu: [绝对不是。尽量别在它们下面待太久。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [REMEMBER YOUR OBSTACLE COURSE TRAINING!]
rows.current: Bossu: [想想你在障碍训练课上学的东西！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OF COURSE, OF COURSE! YIFFAI OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [当然，当然！伊吠下线！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WHAT A STRANGE CREATURE...]
rows.current: Bossu: [好奇怪的生物……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT SEEMS TO BE STUCK TO THE TERRAIN SOMEHOW]
rows.current: Bossu: [它好像不知怎么黏在地形上了，而且只朝一个方向循环移动？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND ONLY MOVES CYCLICALLY IN ONE DIRECTION? ]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NO RECORDS OF ANYTHING LIKE THEM HERE AT HQ]
rows.current: Bossu: [总部这边没有关于它们的任何记录，但它们看起来没什么威胁。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY DON'T SEEM TOO THREATENING.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AS A NANOMECHANICAL ROBOT, THE 'DRILLER' UNITS WILL]
rows.current: Bossu: [作为一种纳米机械机器人，那些'DRILLER'单元会持续自我修复。它们会不知疲倦地钻掘。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CONTINUOUSLY REPAIR THEMSELVES. THEY'LL BURROW TIRELESSLY.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OH! SO THAT'S WHY THEY KEEP COMING BACK?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哦！所以它们才会一直回来？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [BUT HOW DO I GET THROUGH THEM, THEN?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [可那我要怎么穿过去？！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE DRILLER UNITS WILL ONLY OPERATE WITHIN A SET ZONE]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些DRILLER单元只会在一个划定区域内活动]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [I SUGGEST WAITING FOR AN OPENING, OR MAKING ONE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我建议等一个空隙，或者自己开一个。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU'LL BE SAFE ONCE YOU'RE PAST THE MINING ZONE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [一旦过了采矿区，你就安全了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [ALRIGHT THEN, LET'S MAKE A RUN FOR IT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那好，咱们跑过去！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WOW BOSSU, THAT DUDE WAS RIPPED! AND...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇，波苏，那家伙一身肌肉！而且……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [WE HAVE NO PAST REPORTS OF DWARVES IN THE AREA]
rows.current: Bossu: [之前没有矮人出现在这片区域的报告，但它们确实很擅长嗅出稀有矿脉。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY DO TEND TO SNIFF OUT RARE ORE DEPOSITS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HOW ARE THEY SO BIG AND TALL BUT ALSO... SHORT?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [他们怎么能又大又高，却又……那么矮？！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...AND ...AND ALSO SO HUNG!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……而且……而且鸡巴还那么大！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S A TRAIT UNIQUE AMONG THE CANIDS: GIGANTIC DWARFISM]
rows.current: Bossu: [这是犬科独有的特征：巨型侏儒症。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MIND THEIR STRENGTH. A SINGLE PUNCH COULD SEND]
rows.current: Bossu: [当心它们的力气。一拳就能把你打得倒栽葱飞出去。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU FLYING HEAD OVER HEELS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [JEEZE, THINK I'D RATHER GO HEAD DOWN A-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [天啊……那我宁愿脑袋朝下再——]

rows.current: Bossu: [伊吠特工。尽量别分心。]

rows.source: [GRR. JUST RAN INTO A DWARF DOWN HERE.]

rows.current: Bossu: [过去没有这片区域出现矮人的报告，不过他们确实很会嗅出稀有矿藏。]

rows.source: [BUT THEY DO TEND TO SNIFF OUT RARE ORE DEPOSITS.]
[SOUNDS LIKE YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH THEM?]
rows.current: Bossu: [听起来你跟他们打过交道？]

rows.source: [DUDE I MET AT A BAR. ALWAYS MOPING ABOUT ALL THE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [酒吧认识过一个。他老是为输光的那些黄金和珠宝唉声叹气……]

rows.source: [GOLD AND JEWELS HE'D GAMBLED AWAY...]
[OH. WELL THAT HARDLY SEEMS PERTINENT TO-]
rows.current: Bossu: [哦。不过这跟眼下的事没什么——]

rows.source: [ALWAYS GOING ON ABOUT DIGGING DEEPER AND GREEDIER]
rows.current: Yiffany: [总是在念叨着挖得更深、更贪婪，]

rows.source: [AND NEVER SHUTTING UP ABOUT THE DRUMS! EVER LOUDER!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [还没完没了地说着鼓声！越来越响！]
Bossu: [……]

rows.source: [HMPH... YIFFANY OUT.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BUT THEY DO TEND TO SNIFF OUT RARE ORE DEPOSITS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HOW ARE THEY SO BIG AND TALL BUT ALSO... SHORT?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [他们怎么能又大又高，却又……那么矮？！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...AND ...AND ALSO SO HUNG!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……而且……而且鸡巴还那么大！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.source: [YOU FLYING HEAD OVER HEELS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [COME IN. BOSSU?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，我进来了。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [I HOPE NOT, MY BOY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [希望你别进来，孩子。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [NOTHING. WHAT SEEMS TO BE THE PROBLEM?]
rows.current: Bossu: [没什么。遇到什么问题了？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'VE COME ACROSS A BI- PEDAL CANID SPECIES THAT SEEMS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我遇到了一种双足的犬科物种，它好像完全无视我所有的沟通尝试！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [TO BE IGNORING ALL MY ATTEMPTS AT COMMUNICATION!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [NOT ONLY THAT, THEY'RE THROWING ROCKS AT ME!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [而且它们还朝我扔石头！！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY MAY LOOK ORGANIC, BUT BELIEVE IT OR NOT THOSE ARE]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们看着像有机生物，可你信不信，那些是图托恩某个物种的机械复制品——Fenfen。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [MECHANICAL COPIES OF A TUTONE SPECIES, THE FENFEN.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YOU MEAN LIKE... A DRONE, OR A TURRET?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你是说……像无人机，或者炮塔那样？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [RIGHT. IF ANY FLESH AND FUR VARIETIES OF THAT SPECIES ARE]
rows.current: Bossu: [对。要是那物种还有血肉皮毛的真货留在这颗星球上，也还没有特工碰到过它们。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [STILL ON THE PLA- NET, NO AGENTS HAVE RUN INTO THEM YET.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [REPORTS OF FENFEN OUTFITS STREWN ABOUT ARE ALL WE HAVE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我们只有那些关于 FENFEN 服装散落各处的报告。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S CRAZY...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [太离谱了……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE 'FLAMER' IS A MEMBER OF THE DRACONID FAMILY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [“喷火兽”属于龙形科的一员。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY DIG NESTS IN STONE, THEN LAY IN WAIT FOR PREY.]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们在石中挖巢，然后静候猎物。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BEWARE A TERRITORIAL FLAMER; THEY WILL ZEALOUSLY]
rows.current: Bossu: [当心领地意识强的喷火兽；它们会狂热地朝见到的任何闯入者喷火。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SPIT FIRE AT ANY INTERLOPERS THEY SEE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GOT IT, BOSSU. I'LL BE CAREFUL.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [明白，波苏。我会小心的。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AGENT, WATCH OUT FOR THE FLYING DRONES IN THE AREA.]
rows.current: Bossu: [特工，当心这一带的飞行无人机。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I JUST DESTROYED ONE OF THEM!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我刚干掉了一架！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AHH GOOD GOING! SEEMS LIKE THE-]
rows.current: Bossu: [啊，干得好！看来——]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT WAS NO MATCH FOR ME! I WENT HIYAA, THEN ATAA, AN-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [它根本不是我的对手！我先嗨呀，再啊哒，还-]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [CALM DOWN, YIFFAI.]
rows.current: Bossu: [冷静点，伊吠。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [O-OH SORRY, I'LL BEHAVE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊、啊，抱歉，我不闹了……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AHEM, AS I WAS SAYING...]
rows.current: Bossu: [咳嗯，我刚才说到……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THEY'RE ON AN AUTO-ENGAGE ROUTINE. BEST BE PREPARED]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们运行的是自动交战程序。万一你不得不靠近它们，最好有所准备！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IF YOU HAVE TO GET NEAR THEM!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE ROTUND HOVERING DRONES ARE SIMILAR TO THE ONES]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些圆滚滚的悬浮无人机，和你见过在泽罗尼亚周围飞的那种很像。不过，这一型号还配备了爆炸载荷。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU SAW FLYING AROUND ZERONIA. HOWEVER, THIS MODEL]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS ALSO EQUIPPED WITH AN EXPLOSIVE PAYLOAD.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU MAY WISH TO ENGAGE THEM WITH RANGED ATTACKS.]
rows.current: Bossu: [你或许可以用远程攻击来对付它们。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT'S A GOOD IDEA! THANKS BOSSU! OVER.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [好主意！多谢波苏！完毕。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE GHOSTLY HEADS THAT RISE FROM THE GROUND...]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些从地里冒出来的幽灵头颅……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [LET'S CALL THEM "GHOSTERS" FOR NOW.]
rows.current: Bossu: [暂且叫它们「幽灵者」吧。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [REALLY? THAT'S THE BEST YOU CAN DO?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的吗？你就只能想出这个了？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [L-LOOK, THE IMPORTANT THING IS THAT THESE ENEMIES]
rows.current: Bossu: [你、你看，重要的是这些敌人似乎在无休止地涌现。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [SEEM TO BE SPAWNING ENDLESSLY.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT'S ALMOST LIKE THEY'RE MANIFESTATIONS OF]
rows.current: Bossu: [它们简直就像是被扰乱的灵能的化身……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DISTURBED PSYCHIC ENERGY...]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [EITHER WAY, BE CAREFUL, AGENT!]
rows.current: Bossu: [不管怎样，小心点，特工！]

rows.source: [SAAAY BOSSU, I'M NOT A MERMAID, AM I?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我说啊 波苏，我不是人鱼，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BECAUSE I'M DEFIN- ITELY SEEING JELLY FISH AROUND HERE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [因为我在这附近确实看到水母了。]

rows.source: [THE STRANGE HAPPE- NINGS ON TUTONE HAVE LEAD TO]
rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩上发生的怪事，导致有人目击到非实体的水母]

rows.speaker: Bossu

rows.speaker: Yiffany

rows.current: Yiffany: [对我来说它们可实体得很，哎哟……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ON THE CONTRARY, IF YOU'RE TO BELIEVE THE REPORTS...]
rows.current: Bossu: [恰恰相反，如果你相信那些报告的话……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [ANY CREATURE FLASHING OMINOUSLY PURPLE ON TUTONE]
rows.current: Bossu: [在图托恩上闪着不祥紫光的任何生物，其实都是灵能躁动形成的幻影。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IS ACTUALLY AN APPARITION OF PSYCHIC TURMOIL.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HOW YOU DEAL WITH THEM, WE CANNOT SAY FROM HERE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [至于该怎么应付它们，我们在这边可说不准。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HMM, PSYCHIC, YOU SAY.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [唔，你说是灵能啊。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GUESS I'LL HAVE TO FIGURE IT OUT MYSELF...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [看来只能我自己想办法搞清楚了……]

rows.source: [BOSSU, REQUESTING IMMEDIATE UPDATE ON CONDITIONS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [波苏，请立刻确认我的身体状态，确认我没变成水生生物！]

rows.source: [TO VERIFY THAT I AM NOT AN AQUATIC BEING.]
[DON'T WORRY YIFFAI, YOU ARE STILL 100% DOG.]
rows.current: Bossu: [放心，伊吠，你还是100%的狗。]

rows.source: [THE STRANGE HAPPE- NINGS ON TUTONE HAVE LEAD TO]
rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩的异变导致有人目击到没有实体的水母，可能正是它们让你怀疑起自己来了。]

rows.source: [SIGHTINGS OF NON- PHYSICAL JELLY FISH]
[WHICH MIGHT BE CAUSING YOU TO THINK OTHERWISE.]
[THEY SEEM PLENTY PHYSICAL TO ME, OW...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我可觉得它们实在得很，哎哟……]

rows.source: [ON THE CONTRARY, IF YOU'RE TO BELIEVE THE REPORTS...]
rows.current: Bossu: [恰恰相反，如果那些报告可信的话……]

rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩上任何闪着不祥紫光的生物，其实都是灵能动荡产生的幻象。]

rows.current: Bossu: [至于你该怎么应付它们，我们从这边说不准。]

rows.current: Yiffai: [嗯，你是说灵能啊。]

rows.source: [GUESS I'LL HAVE TO FIGURE IT OUT MYSELF...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看来只能我自己想办法搞清楚了……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BOSSU, REPORTING A GREEN LIZARD TAIL SIGHTING.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，报告发现一条绿色蜥蜴尾巴。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AHH YOU'VE RUN INTO SOME KOBOLDS DOWN THERE, HAVE YOU?]
rows.current: Bossu: [啊，你在下面碰上科博德了是吧？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THIS ISN'T THE FIRST TIME I'VE HAD CONTACT WITH THEM]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我跟它们打交道不是头一回了，但没想到它们会出现在这颗星球上！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BUT I WASN'T EXPECTING THEM TO BE ON THIS PLANET!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOSE LIZARDS ARE A SLY BUNCH, KNOWN FOR PIRACY AND SLAVING]
rows.current: Bossu: [那些蜥蜴狡猾得很，干海盗和贩奴的勾当出了名，凡是最后能捞到 lect 的事，他们都干！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AND ANYTHING ELSE THAT HAS A LECT PAYOFF AT THE END!]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [EARLY REPORTS WERE THAT MANY OF YOUR FELLOW AGENTS HAD]
rows.current: Bossu: [早先的报告说，你的不少同僚特工已经被科博德抓去了。能救就救他们回来，哪怕这得先做点交易，才能保证特工的安全。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [BEEN CAPTURED BY KOBOLDS. RESCUE THEM IF YOU CAN, EVEN IF]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT REQUIRES DOING BUSINESS IN ORDER TO ENSURE AGENT SAFETY]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [UNDERSTOOD, I'LL KEEP AN EYE OUT FOR SLAVER SHOPS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [明白，我会留意那些奴隶商店。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WOAH! DID YOU PICK UP THAT EXPLOSION AT HQ?!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇哦！总部那边有接到那声爆炸吗？！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [INDEED, IT APPEARS THE MINES OF TUTONE HAVE BEEN MINED.]
rows.current: Bossu: [确实，看来图托恩的矿区，处处都是“雷区”。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...? WELL SURE, BUT WHAT'S THAT GOTTA DO WITH EXPLOSIONS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……？挖矿有那么多忌讳？可这跟爆炸有什么关系？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE EXPLOSIONS FROM THE MINES.]
rows.current: Bossu: [我是说，雷区里的雷炸了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! IT WAS IN THE MINES, BUT-]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对啊！矿区里炸了，可是——]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [WHAT BOSSU MEANS IS THAT THOSE OLD MINERS PLACED]
rows.current: Mauser: [波苏是说，那些老矿工在自家的矿井里埋了地雷，意思是：“这是我的矿，谁也别碰！”]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [MINES IN THEIR MINES, AS A WAY TO SAY "THAT'S MINE!"]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT...?! I'LL JUST AVOID THEM, OKAY?! Y-YIFFAI OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么……？！那我就躲开它们，行吧？！伊、伊吠通话完毕！]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [IT SEEMS LIKE PROXIMITY MINES ALL OVER THE AREA ]
rows.current: Bossu: [看样子，这片区域到处的感应地雷，都因持续震动而激活了触发装置。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [HAD THEIR TRIGGERS ACTIVATED DUE TO THE CONSTANT TREMORS]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [DARN... IS THERE ANY WAY I CAN DEAL WITH THEM?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [可恶……有什么办法对付它们吗？]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THERE ARE TWO WAYS TO DO SO.]
rows.current: Bossu: [有两种办法。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GREAT! I'M LISTENING.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [太好了！我听着呢。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOU CAN EITHER GET NEAR THEM SO THAT THEY DESTRUCT]
rows.current: Bossu: [你可以靠近它们，让它们自爆，也可以打它们，让它们爆炸。你选吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [OR STRIKE THEM TO CAUSE THEM TO EX- PLODE. YOUR CHOICE]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YOU'RE NOT SERIOUS, ARE YOU...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你不是认真的吧……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THOUGHT YOU WOULDN'T MINE A LIL HUMOR FOR A CHANGE.]
rows.current: Bossu: [还以为偶尔开个玩笑，不会踩到你的雷呢。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [I SAID-]
rows.current: Bossu: [我说——]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [LINE'S BREAKING UP, GOTTA GO!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [信号断断续续，先挂了！]

rows.source: [IT SEEMS LIKE PROXIMITY MINES ALL OVER THE AREA ]
rows.current: Bossu: [看来这片区域的感应地雷都被持续的震动激活了引信。]

rows.source: [HAD THEIR TRIGGERS ACTIVATED DUE TO THE CONSTANT TREMORS]
[ISN'T THERE SOME WAY TO DEACTIVATE THEM AGAIN?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [就没办法把它们再关掉吗？]

rows.source: [THERE ARE TWO WAYS TO DO SO.]
rows.current: Bossu: [有两种办法。]

rows.source: [REALLY? GREAT! TELL ME HOW!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的？太好了！快告诉我怎么做！]

rows.source: [YOU CAN EITHER GET NEAR THEM SO THAT THEY DESTRUCT]
rows.current: Bossu: [你可以靠近它们，诱使它们自爆，或者打它们，让它们爆炸。你自己选]

rows.source: [OR STRIKE THEM TO CAUSE THEM TO EX- PLODE. YOUR CHOICE]

rows.current: Yiffany: [……]

rows.source: [I REMEMBER WHEN I GOT ACTUAL_HINTS FROM THIS LINE...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [以前这条线还能给点真正_有用的提示……]

rows.source: [HAHA, DON'T WORRY AGENT. I KNOW YOU CAN HANDLE IT.]
rows.current: Bossu: [哈哈，别担心，特工。我相信你能搞定。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BOSSU, I'VE JUST DETONATED AN EXPLOSIVE DEVICE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏，我刚引爆了一枚爆炸装置。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [THE MINES OF TUTONE APPEAR TO BE FILLED WITH BOOBY-TRAPS]
rows.current: Bossu: [图托恩的矿区里似乎布满了诡雷，也许是为了保护残存无几的矿脉。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [PERHAPS TO PROTECT WHAT SCANT VEINS YET REMAIN.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [I RECOMMEND GIVING BLINKING DEVICES A WIDE BERTH, OR]
rows.current: Bossu: [我建议离闪烁的装置远一些，或者在远处引爆它们。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [DETONATING THEM FROM AFAR.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GOT IT, BOSSU.]
